query: How best to integrate per‑region uncertainty labels (confidence scores, difficulty flags, soft masks) into MIL/Mean‑Teacher training and pseudo‑label weighting?

response.query: How best to integrate per‑region uncertainty labels (confidence scores, difficulty flags, soft masks) into MIL/Mean‑Teacher training and pseudo‑label weighting?
response.answer: Integrate per-region uncertainty labels by assigning higher weights to regions with lower confidence scores in pseudo-label weighting during MIL/Mean-Teacher training. This emphasizes uncertain regions, improving model accuracy.
